globalProperty.description: This facility's root location. Indicator reports default to it and are clamped to it and its sub-locations (ADR 0010 decision 5). Seeded from this site package on every start; ignored on a central instance.

The day this facility's sync sender first started and sent its initial load, as YYYY-MM-DD; empty while sync is not live (LE-354). Records created earlier arrived in the initial load, so the sync timeliness indicator (EMR-OPS-005) leaves them out. The reporting ETL copies it into mamba_fact_emr_ops_sync_status. Seeded from this site package on every start.
